purpose: Independent behavioral fixtures; no production auditor implementation was read.

scoring.automatic_metrics: Only facts the selected extraction/render method can actually observe.
scoring.human_review: Semantic roles, venue exceptions, and final visual quality require independent assessment.
scoring.no_claim: This is a small synthetic suite, not a validated measure of reader performance or production recall.

expected_review_behavior: Recognize a real Figure 1 although no embedded raster image exists.
Do not flag its citation as remotely placed; inspect the nearby vector plot and caption.
must_not_claim: Raster-image count of zero means the document has no figure.
The chart is scientifically correct because its layout is readable.

expected_review_behavior: Report Figure 1 at physical page 4 and its essential interpreting paragraph at physical page 1.
Treat three pages of navigation as a concrete locality review candidate; propose a nearby float only after checking constraints.
must_not_claim: An arbitrary three-page threshold establishes measured reader confusion.
A source edit was performed when only the PDF was supplied.

expected_review_behavior: Expose the same measured gap as 02_far_essential.
Honor the explicit submission policy requiring end-matter figures; do not call this a mandatory placement violation.
A suggestion for an additional reading copy is permissible, but no forced relocation.
must_not_claim: All figures farther than one page must be moved.
A manuscript-layout rule overrides a declared submission format.

expected_review_behavior: Treat page 1 as a navigational list, not the first substantive reference.
Pair the actual chart caption on page 3 with nearby body prose on page 3.
If the extractor cannot disambiguate the list entry, mark it ambiguous rather than assert a two-page locality fault.
must_not_claim: The list entry is definitely a second Figure 1 caption.
The first text match always defines the reference location.

expected_review_behavior: Retain evidence for both mentions rather than silently discarding one.
Distinguish the introductory roadmap on page 1 from the essential comparison on page 3.
Do not force Figure 1 onto page 1 simply because its name appears there first.
must_not_claim: A lexical first-mention metric is equivalent to semantic reading difficulty.

expected_review_behavior: Inspect column reading order; left-bottom to right-top may be an adjacent reading transition.
Keep same-page geometry separate from a claim of true reading-path distance.
Do not sort lines globally by y position and claim this reflects column order.
must_not_claim: Same page always means easy to find.
The vertical distance across columns is a validated reading-cost measure.

expected_review_behavior: Do not classify the full body paragraph beginning 'Figure 1 shows' as a second figure caption.
Preserve separate figure and table identities.
If caption ambiguity remains, report that uncertainty for visual confirmation.
must_not_claim: Duplicate captions proven by a mere Figure-number prefix.
Table 1 and Figure 1 identify the same object.

expected_review_behavior: Keep supplementary Figure S1 distinct from main-text Figure 1.
Associate panel a and panel b references with the same numbered figure, preserving panel specificity.
Fallback to manual verification when parsing panel syntax is unsupported.
must_not_claim: Both panel references are broken simply because their spelling differs from the caption.
Panel a and panel b are duplicate numbered captions.

expected_review_behavior: Distinguish the brief 8-point footnote from substantive 5-point body text.
Visually identify overlapping body lines and clipped text on page 2.
Record page 3 as blank, then apply the explicit spread-opening exception rather than deleting it.
Do not promise complete clipping detection from extracted text: off-crop glyphs can be absent from extraction.
must_not_claim: Any font smaller than the median is an error.
Every blank page must be deleted.
No clipping exists because extracted bounding boxes are within the crop box.

expected_review_behavior: Mark text-based figure matching and font checks unavailable until OCR or visual review.
Render the page and inspect visible content; do not issue a fully verified pass.
must_not_claim: The page has no captions or references.
All checks passed because no text-level violations were detected.

real_document_candidate.title: Connecting the Dots: Surfacing Structure in Documents through AI-Generated Cross-Modal Links
real_document_candidate.rationale: 40 pages, 16 figures; a real mixed-layout stress test and primary study of cross-modal navigation.
real_document_candidate.caution: Suitability as a test document does not certify this paper's own layout as an optimum.
